verdict.rationale: YYLO's CLI supports scripted/headless usage (yy pi --no-session, yy loop for shell commands, parallel-runner for bounded concurrent fan-out, run-until-completion for looping) and CI-friendly non-interactive commands with structured watch receipts (state COMPLETED, exit_code) that scripts can parse. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline integration doc (e.g. GitHub Actions example), no mention of exit-code contracts across all commands, and no evidence of headless auth/credential handling in CI. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI config), documented non-interactive auth flow for CI runners, and independent corroboration of pipeline usage.
